subtitle.zh-CN: 水豚噜噜 · 南瓜小帽
subtitle.zh-TW: 水豚嚕嚕 · 南瓜小帽

description.zh-CN: 头顶小南瓜的水豚，佛系、悠闲，最爱泡澡和放假，天塌下来也慢慢来。
description.zh-TW: 頭頂小南瓜的水豚，佛系、悠閒，最愛泡澡和放假，天塌下來也慢慢來。
description.en: A laid-back capybara with a little pumpkin on its head. Loves baths and holidays, and takes everything slowly.

look: capybara: light warm-yellow body (#f9cf55), big orange muzzle covering the lower face and orange "shorts" (#f08a3c), rounded-rectangle head merging into a barrel body, small round ears on top, round glossy dark eyes with a white highlight, tiny calm mouth, small orange pumpkin with a brown stem on top of the head, short arms, stubby feet, small round tail
